note: Final Chairman artwork, delivered by the creative director and signed off by the founder. Masters live under assets/source/ and are not served. The files the page loads live beside them in assets/ and were produced by deterministic resize and re-encode of those masters: no repainting, no new artwork. The reply bank under assets/source/reply-bank/ is composed from one approved portrait and is for X replies only; it is not used on the page.

fields.id: Stable asset id referenced by code and by this manifest.
fields.version: Integer, incremented on every re-delivery of the same id.
fields.path: Repository-relative path of the primary file.
fields.fallback: Repository-relative path, format and size of the fallback encoding, when the slot ships two.
fields.source: Repository-relative path of the delivered master this file was derived from, or null when this entry is the master.
fields.dimensions: Pixel width and height of the file at path.
fields.altText: Accessible description used verbatim in markup.
fields.safeCrops: Crops the art must survive without losing the subject.
fields.allowedUse: Where this asset may be published.
fields.caption: Post copy delivered with the asset, used verbatim when the asset is published.
fields.referenceNotes: External visual references, recorded for review before commercial publication.
